name: mes_mes_list_my_sites
description: Use first to see which MES site areas the user is assigned to and which one is currently selected. Returns the site names. Read-only.

name: mes_mes_list_machines
description: Use to find machines (production lines) and their current state across all the user’s sites. Only machines the user is assigned to are listed. Shows at most 100. Read-only.

name: mes_mes_list_jobs
description: Use for questions that list jobs: in progress, ready, on a machine, of a production order or in a shift. Covers all the user’s sites; every line shows its site. All inputs optional. If Shift is given only the shift filter is used; else if ProductionOrder is given only that is used; else Status, JobCodeContains and Machine apply together. Read-only.

name: mes_mes_job_counts
description: Use for ’how many jobs’ questions. Returns job counts by status for each of the user’s sites, plus totals, so no listing is needed. Read-only.

name: mes_mes_get_job
description: Use for everything about one job. Always returns the header (status, progress, machine, lots with required and produced quantities). Add sections with Include only when needed. Read-only.

name: mes_mes_find_lot
description: Use when you only have a lot code or ERP tag. Looks for it as a production lot on jobs and as an inventory lot, across all the user’s sites. Then call mes_get_job or mes_get_lot for full details. Read-only.

name: mes_mes_why_lot_unavailable
description: Use to explain why a lot cannot be used for a job (status, quantity, location or allocation). Read-only.

name: mes_mes_list_production_orders
description: Use to list production orders with status, customer and required quantity across all the user’s sites. Read-only.

name: mes_mes_get_production_order
description: Use for one production order: header plus its jobs (jobs included by default). Read-only.

name: mes_mes_get_machine
description: Use for one machine. Include chooses what to return: queue, state_history, comments, documents (default queue and state_history). Only machines the user is assigned to. Read-only.

name: mes_mes_get_shift_window
description: Use to turn ’this shift’ into a start and end time for the user’s current site. Read-only.

name: mes_mes_list_inventory_lots
description: Use to find inventory lots by item, status or storage location across all the user’s sites (first 25). Read-only.

name: mes_mes_inventory_summary
description: Use for totals of inventory lots by status across all the user’s sites. Read-only.

name: mes_mes_get_lot
description: Use for everything about one inventory lot. Always returns the header (item, quantity, status, location, dates). Add sections with Include: history, movements, traceability, ncm, quality. Read-only.

name: mes_mes_list_storage
description: Use to list storage locations (default) or storage units (Type = units; needs the storage unit role) across all the user’s sites. Read-only.

name: mes_mes_list_quality_orders
description: Use to list quality orders (latest 25) across all the user’s sites. Read-only.

name: mes_mes_get_quality_order
description: Use for one quality order with its parameters, limits and recorded values. Add history with Include. Read-only.

name: mes_mes_quality_counts
description: Use for how many quality orders there are by status across all the user’s sites. Read-only.

name: mes_mes_list_rework
description: Use to list rework tasks (latest 30) across all the user’s sites, or pass TaskId for one task with its lot, machine, consumption and progress. Read-only.

name: mes_mes_search_knowledge
description: Use for how-to and policy questions. Searches uploaded and SharePoint documents (documents), returns the site team’s saved knowledge (site_knowledge) and can list help topics (help_topics). Read-only.

name: mes_mes_list_documents
description: Use to list the available documents (uploaded and SharePoint), or the document names attached to a job or a machine. Names only, no files. Read-only.

name: mes_mes_get_help_topic
description: Use to read one help topic. Get the TopicId from mes_search_knowledge with Sources = help_topics. Read-only.
